name: co-vat-return
description: Colombian VAT (IVA, impuesto sobre las ventas) for 2026: who must register as responsable de IVA (the 3,500 UVT tests in ET art. 437 par. 3, 4,000 UVT for State contractors), what is taxed (art. 420), the 19% general rate (art. 468), the 5% goods and services (arts. 468-1, 468-3), excluded goods and services with no credit (arts. 424, 476: health, education, public transport and freight, utilities, residential rent, interest, hosting and cloud) and exempt supplies with credit and refund (arts. 477, 478, 481: fresh meat, milk, eggs, rice, exports of goods and services), the base and tax point, input IVA and its limits (arts. 485, 488, 490, 491, 496), IVA withholding at 15% (arts. 437-1, 437-2), bimonthly or four-monthly periods at 92,000 UVT (art. 600), Form 300 boxes, 2026 deadlines by NIT and penalties. UVT 2026 COP 52,374. Trigger on: IVA Colombia, declaración de IVA formulario 300, responsable de IVA, no responsable 3.500 UVT, IVA bimestral cuatrimestral, IVA descontable, reteIVA, e
